title: Subject selector
lead: Pick six subjects with HL/SL and see instantly whether the combination is valid, meets the diploma requirements, meets New Zealand UE, and keeps your target pathways open.

step1.schoolHint: Choosing a school filters the subject list when we know what it offers. Verify with the school and the official IB directory.
step1.dpStartYear: Year the student starts the DP
step1.dpStartYearHint: Used to tell you which syllabus applies - see Curriculum updates.
step1.nativeLanguage: Is English the student's best language?
step1.examSessionHint: New Zealand schools typically sit the November session in Year 13; most northern-hemisphere schools sit May. This decides which syllabus applies - confirm it with the school.

step2.slot6: Group 6 or a second subject from Groups 1-4

step4.defaultGradeHint: Subjects with no predicted grade are estimated at 4.

status.indeterminate: Cannot be decided ({{passMark}} is the pass mark)
status.incomplete: Not a complete diploma yet ({{count}} of {{required}} subjects)
status.incomplete-structure: The subject combination is not valid, so the diploma conditions cannot be judged

pathways.guidanceOnly: These are generic subject-choice guidelines from our data, not admission decisions. Entry routes differ by country, university and programme - for example, New Zealand school leavers enter medicine through a first-year university programme, not directly from school. Always check each university's own page.

errors.subject-count: A diploma needs exactly {{expected}} subjects; you have {{actual}}.
errors.hl-count: You need 3 or 4 HL subjects; you have {{actual}}.
errors.math-count: Exactly one mathematics subject is required; you have {{actual}}.
errors.group-coverage: Groups 1-5 must each be covered, and the sixth subject must come from Group 6 or be a valid second subject from Groups 1-4.
errors.level-not-offered-this-year: {{code}} is not offered at {{level}} for the {{year}} examination session (that level exists only in a different syllabus version).
errors.subject-not-offered-this-year: {{code}} is not examined in {{year}} - it is being replaced by an updated course.

ue.ue-literacy: Missing the UE literacy requirement: English Language A (HL or SL), or English Language B (HL).
ue.ue-numeracy: Missing the UE numeracy requirement: any mathematics subject.

diploma.indeterminate: Some official thresholds are still marked as to be verified, so the result cannot be decided yet.
